_comment: Every application TypeScript diagnostic is fatal; there is no diagnostic allowance. applicationNoCheckFileCount is an exact count of application source files carrying @ts-nocheck (R2/#2811 item 5 ported to the app ratchet); it is 0 because none currently exist, and any new @ts-nocheck'd file must be fixed rather than absorbed by raising this count. minimumAppFileCount is a lower bound set to the measured application file count, 851 after the deliberate removal of seven dead application files in PR #2925; lowering it is only legitimate alongside a deliberate removal or exclusion in the same commit, and the bound is a floor so it goes slack as files are added.
